narr: A strongly unstable air mass developed over south Texas ahead of a frontal boundary on April 25th. Severe storms developed ahead of the boundary and moved south over the Coastal Bend during the late afternoon and early evening. Storms produced wind damage across Jim Wells County during the late afternoon.
ev: Emergency management reported flash flooding along Farm to Market Road 799 and County Road 329. Water flowing over the road was up to a depth of 1 foot.
lsr: EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT REPORTED FLASH FLOODING ALONG FM 799 AND CR 324. WATER FLOWING ABOUT 1 FOOT OVER ROAD.
